items.description: A recorded time entry in the complete replacement collection.

entries.description: Complete replacement set of recorded time entries. Omit to preserve all entries; [] requests removal of all entries. Null is not accepted.

comment.description: Replacement timesheet comment as ordinary text. Omit to preserve; null requests clearing; an empty string remains an explicitly empty comment.

entries.description: Complete replacement set of recorded time entries. Omit to preserve all entries; [] requests removal of all entries. Null is not accepted.
